instruction: Open the most recently closed tab again.

metadata.explanation: Task variation using social media websites (reddit.com, twitter.com, facebook.com). User needs to reopen the most recently closed tab (facebook.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator checks if all 3 tabs are open using the existing is_expected_tabs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves all open tabs using get_open_tabs_info getter
Metric function is_expected_tabs properly extracts URLs from tabs and compares against expected URLs
Expected value correctly specifies all 3 URLs (reddit, twitter, facebook) that should be open after reopening
Metric correctly handles the rules parameter structure when expected.type='rule'
Verification logic is complete - checking all 3 tabs are open confirms facebook.com was successfully reopened
No state timing issues - open tabs list is always accessible without special postconfig
